name: slice
expr: slice(V, sx, sy, sz); s = size(V); r = s(1); c = s(2); p = s(3); v_max = max(V(:));
comment: slice is display-only — fingerprint pins V's shape + extrema to confirm the call doesn't mutate the volume. MATLAB / numkit / Octave all produce a 3-D figure; visual fidelity (per-cell colour gradient via vertexColors) is covered by e2e in slice.spec.js.
